output.text: {"notes":["The requested readout is at absolute simulation time t=2.0 s; position is a world-frame vector in meters, swing angle is in radians, and angular velocity is in rad/s.","The world frame is right-handed with +x forward, +y left, and +z up; positive swing angle displaces the load toward +x.","A scheduled support intervention runs on [0.596, 0.796) s: +0.22910081336731192 m/s² for 0.1 s, then the opposite acceleration for 0.1 s, after which the support is stationary.","boundary_crossed denotes whether the load center of mass crosses x=0.1 m after the observation cutoff, using 0.005 m hysteresis."]}
